title: BAR Module 4 · TBS 3
html:
TASK-BASED SIMULATION

Reconciliation Analysis

Reconcile governmental fund operating results to the change in net position of governmental activities.

Scenario

The City of Westbrook reports an $420,000 increase in total governmental fund balances for the current year.

Additional information follows.

  • Capital outlays reported as governmental fund expenditures: $180,000
  • Depreciation expense applicable to governmental activities: $55,000
  • Principal payments on general long-term debt reported as governmental fund expenditures: $45,000
  • General long-term bond proceeds reported as an other financing source: $160,000
  • Revenue recognized at the government-wide level but not recognized in governmental funds solely because it was unavailable: $30,000

Required

Enter each adjustment using the signed amount. Use a positive number for an addition and a negative number for a subtraction.

1. Capital Outlay Adjustment
2. Depreciation Adjustment
3. Debt Principal Adjustment
4. Bond Proceeds Adjustment
5. Revenue Availability Adjustment
6. Change in Governmental Activities' Net Position

fields.label: 1. Capital Outlay Adjustment
fields.explanation: The correct response is 180000. The worked solution explains the associated governmental accounting treatment.

fields.label: 2. Depreciation Adjustment
fields.explanation: The correct response is -55000. The worked solution explains the associated governmental accounting treatment.

fields.label: 3. Debt Principal Adjustment
fields.explanation: The correct response is 45000. The worked solution explains the associated governmental accounting treatment.

fields.label: 4. Bond Proceeds Adjustment
fields.explanation: The correct response is -160000. The worked solution explains the associated governmental accounting treatment.

fields.label: 5. Revenue Availability Adjustment
fields.explanation: The correct response is 30000. The worked solution explains the associated governmental accounting treatment.

fields.label: 6. Change in Governmental Activities' Net Position
fields.explanation: The correct response is 460000. The worked solution explains the associated governmental accounting treatment.

explanation:
Capital Outlay

Governmental funds treated the $180,000 capital outlay as an expenditure. Government-wide accounting generally capitalizes the asset.

Adjustment = +$180,000

Depreciation

Depreciation is recognized as an expense at the government-wide level.

Adjustment = −$55,000

Debt Principal

Governmental funds treated the $45,000 principal payment as an expenditure. Government-wide accounting treats it as a reduction of the liability.

Adjustment = +$45,000

Bond Proceeds

The governmental funds included $160,000 of bond proceeds as an other financing source.

Government-wide accounting instead recognizes a long-term liability.

Adjustment = −$160,000

Revenue Availability

The $30,000 was excluded from governmental fund revenue solely because it failed the modified-accrual availability criterion.

It qualifies for recognition under government-wide accrual accounting.

Adjustment = +$30,000

Final Reconciliation

Increase in Fund Balances $420,000 + Capital Outlay $180,000 − Depreciation $55,000 + Principal Payment $45,000 − Bond Proceeds $160,000 + Revenue Adjustment $30,000 = $460,000 CHANGE IN NET POSITION

CPA Takeaway

  • Capital outlay → add back.
  • Depreciation → subtract.
  • Debt principal payment → add back.
  • Bond proceeds → subtract.
  • Accrual revenue excluded only because of availability → add.
